svg.title: BegaIA Operating Model — View B — INTERNAL
svg.desc: Derived, non-contractual hybrid lifecycle view of a governed hito. Four horizontal-time flow-position bands organize gates, checkpoints, evidence and protected Human Authority execution boundaries. Gates enable transitions, Human Authority materializes protected actions, and CERRADO is the single terminal hito state after documentary materialization and traceability have been verified.

g.text: BegaIA Operating Model — View B — INTERNAL
Un hito avanza sólo cuando la evidencia exigida por su clasificación satisface el gate siguiente;
los gates habilitan, Human Authority materializa las acciones protegidas y CERRADO existe únicamente tras materialización y trazabilidad documental verificadas.
Runtime Map — when product runtime is affected

MATERIAL EVIDENCE RAIL · existing_repo_change · CODE → COMMIT → HASH → PUSH → DOC
Canonicality: phase ≠ state · verdict ≠ state · readiness ≠ state · artifact state ≠ hito state · reconciliation is conditional.
Boundary continuity: View A roles are touchpoints only · View C authority is temporal only · View E remains documentary context · View D scope is Operating Model System only.
No historical example or identity is elevated to contract; no rule is created.
